desc:
🌾 Welcome to +1 Crop Harvest!

1. Train your Strength 💪
2. Harvest the crops 🌽
3. Find rare treasure and sell it! 💰
4. Buy stronger scythes, upgrades and Auras ⬆️
5. Craft powerful Artifacts from your treasure ✨
6. Rebirth and harvest the WHOLE field! 🔄

🍭 Unlock the CANDY FIELD, a sweet new world full of bigger treasures!

💤 Earn Strength and Money even while you're OFFLINE!

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT: complete quests for Pumpkin Tokens and unlock spooky scythes and Artifacts! (Limited time!)
